response.overview: Marisa Pete's life is turned upside down when her ex-husband James claims he is dying of aggressive cancer and asks her to care for him in his final weeks. Against her better judgment and with reluctant support from her husband, Stephone Marisa brings James into their home. As James' condition fluctuates and tensions rise, unsettling clues begin to surface. What appears to be compassion soon reveals itself as manipulation, with life or death consequences, forcing Marisa to confront a terrifying truth before it's too late.
response.title: A Deadly Proposal
